result.instructions: Tools for Typesense, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which collections do we have, and how many documents are in each?"; "Search our products for 'waterproof jacket' under 150 and show the brands."; "Show the synonym sets that map words to each other for our help-center search.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Typesense data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run typesense_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run typesense_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run typesense_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. typesense_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: typesense_get_health
tools.title: Check server health
tools.description: Check whether the Typesense server is ready to accept requests. Typesense API: GET /health.

tools.name: typesense_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List all collections with their names, field schemas, document counts and default sorting field. Good first call to see what is searchable. Typesense API: GET /collections.

tools.name: typesense_get_collection
tools.title: Get a collection
tools.description: Get one collection: its field schema, document count and settings. Typesense API: GET /collections/{collectionName}.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

tools.name: typesense_search
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Search one collection with typo-tolerant full-text search, filters, sorting, facets and pagination. Returns hits, found count and facet counts. Typesense API: GET /collections/{collectionName}/documents/search.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

q.description: Search text. Use "*" to match all documents, for example with filter_by only.

query_by.description: Comma-separated text fields to match, for example title,description. Typesense requires it.

facet_by.description: Comma-separated fields to count values for, for example brand,category.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return in each hit.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to leave out of each hit.

prefix.description: Prefix matching per query field, for example "true" or "true,false".

num_typos.description: Typo tolerance per query field, for example "2" or "1,2".

tools.name: typesense_multi_search
tools.title: Search several collections
tools.description: Run up to 10 searches in one request, each on its own collection, and return one result per search. Typesense API: POST /multi_search.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

q.description: Search text. Use "*" to match all documents, for example with filter_by only.

query_by.description: Comma-separated text fields to match, for example title,description. Typesense requires it.

facet_by.description: Comma-separated fields to count values for, for example brand,category.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return in each hit.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to leave out of each hit.

prefix.description: Prefix matching per query field, for example "true" or "true,false".

num_typos.description: Typo tolerance per query field, for example "2" or "1,2".

searches.description: The searches to run. Each item has a collection and the same fields as typesense_search.

tools.name: typesense_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document from a collection by its id. Typesense API: GET /collections/{collectionName}/documents/{documentId}.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

tools.name: typesense_list_synonym_sets
tools.title: List synonym sets
tools.description: List all synonym sets (words treated as equal in search). Typesense API: GET /synonym_sets.

tools.name: typesense_get_synonym_set
tools.title: Get a synonym set
tools.description: Get one synonym set and its items. Typesense API: GET /synonym_sets/{synonymSetName}.

name.description: Name of the synonym set, curation set or alias.

tools.name: typesense_list_curation_sets
tools.title: List curation sets
tools.description: List all curation sets (pinned and hidden results rules). Typesense API: GET /curation_sets.

tools.name: typesense_list_aliases
tools.title: List aliases
tools.description: List all collection aliases. An alias points to a collection, so an app can switch collections without a code change. Typesense API: GET /aliases.

tools.name: typesense_get_alias
tools.title: Get an alias
tools.description: Get one alias and the collection it points to. Typesense API: GET /aliases/{aliasName}.

name.description: Name of the synonym set, curation set or alias.

tools.name: typesense_list_analytics_rules
tools.title: List analytics rules
tools.description: List analytics rules that count searches or clicks into popular-query collections. Optionally filter by rule_tag. Typesense API: GET /analytics/rules.

tools.name: typesense_create_collection
tools.title: Create a collection
tools.description: Create a new collection with a field schema. Fails with HTTP 409 if the name already exists. Writes data structure only: it stores no documents. Typesense API: POST /collections.

type.description: Typesense field type, for example string, string[], int32, int64, float, bool, geopoint or auto.

optional.description: true if documents may omit this field.

facet.description: true to allow facet_by on this field.

index.description: false to store the field without indexing it.

sort.description: true to allow sort_by on this field.

fields.description: The field schema. Each field needs a name and a type.

default_sorting_field.description: A numeric field used as the default sort. Must be one of the fields.

tools.name: typesense_upsert_document
tools.title: Create or replace a document
tools.description: Create a document, or replace it when a document with the same id exists. The document must include its id, so a retry replaces the same document. Typesense API: POST /collections/{collectionName}/documents?action=upsert.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

document.description: The whole document as a JSON object. It must include a string id field.

tools.name: typesense_update_document
tools.title: Update fields of a document
tools.description: Change some fields of an existing document and keep the rest. Only the given fields change. Calling it twice with the same data gives the same result. Typesense API: PATCH /collections/{collectionName}/documents/{documentId}.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

fields.description: The fields to change, with their new values.

tools.name: typesense_delete_document
tools.title: Delete a document
tools.description: Delete one document by id. This tool cannot restore a deleted document. Typesense API: DELETE /collections/{collectionName}/documents/{documentId}.

collection.description: Collection name, for example products (from typesense_list_collections).

prompts.title: Get started with Typesense
prompts.description: What you can do with Typesense here, with example requests to try.
